subject: oop
question: Write a Java program demonstrating a class implementing two interfaces.
title: One Class, Two Certificates
hook: A swimming certificate and a flying certificate: one Duck holds both.
answer: interface Flyer { void fly(); }  interface Swimmer { void swim(); }  (declarations only, no body)
class Duck implements Flyer, Swimmer  (names separated by a comma)
Duck must define BOTH methods and make them public: public void fly() {...}  public void swim() {...}
main: Duck d = new Duck(); d.fly(); d.swim();
Output: Duck flies / Duck swims. One object answers to both interfaces.
